name: NIE 3
source:
Three girls compete to be the bride. Main character needs an enduring wife, so he organizes a series of severe compatibility tests.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]

三個女孩競爭新娘之位。主角想娶一個能忍耐的妻子，於是安排了一連串嚴格的考驗，看看誰和他最合得來。
